description: The right curled end of this single painted shape softly bends a few pixels left, then right, then returns. Its left base stays pinned in exactly the same position. The whole shape keeps its original flattened height and horizontal footprint. One smooth restrained sway. Maintain constant color, light and opacity. Nothing grows, appears, breaks away or disappears. Fixed camera and transparent background.
subject_description: One small flattened orange and yellow curved brushstroke on transparency
initial_pose: A low horizontal curved silhouette with its broad left base anchored and a slightly raised right tip
